entries.995989221082afb2: Joshin Corporation forms the Joshin Group with 13 consolidated subsidiaries (as of March 31, 2026). The company operates specialty stores for home appliances, information and communication equipment, entertainment products and housing equipment as its core business. Joshin Service handles delivery, installation and repair; Japuro handles equipment installation and setup; Joshin Tech handles insurance agency and long-term repair warranty operations; and Joshin Reform Kinki handles remodeling; the company outsources part of store operations to six regional Joshin companies. In April 2026, the company changed its trade name from “Joshin Denki Co., Ltd.” to “Joshin Corporation.”

entries.a33a49bc43a99a26: Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥436,650 million (108.3% of the prior-year period, an increase of 8.3%). In-store sales were ¥354,911 million and internet sales were ¥79,004 million. Growth in air conditioner sales due to extreme heat, mobile phone and personal computer sales supported by replacement demand, and expanded video game sales from the launch of new products contributed. The company explains that sales tied to the Hanshin Tigers’ league championship also contributed greatly to the increase in sales.
